definitions.explanation: One complete revolution around a track, course, or celestial body. Also used as a counter for laps.
The act of traveling around a place or area, making a full circuit.

examples.japanese: あと{三|さん}{周回|しゅうかい}で{終|お}わりだ。
{最終|さいしゅう}{周回|しゅうかい}でトップに{立|た}った。
examples.english: He took the lead on the final lap.

examples.japanese: {人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}が{地球|ちきゅう}を{周回|しゅうかい}している。
examples.english: The artificial satellite is orbiting the Earth.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}を{周回|しゅうかい}するコースを{走|はし}った。
examples.english: I ran the course that goes around the park.

examples.japanese: {湖|みずうみ}を{周回|しゅうかい}するドライブは{景色|けしき}がよかった。
examples.english: The drive around the lake had beautiful scenery.

examples.japanese: {島|しま}を{船|ふね}で{周回|しゅうかい}するツアーに{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I joined a tour that goes around the island by boat.

notes:
A compound of {周|しゅう} (around) and {回|かい} (turn, revolve).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周回|しゅうかい}コース (circuit course, lap course)
- {周回|しゅうかい}レース (circuit race)
- {周回|しゅうかい}{遅|おく}れ (being a lap behind)
- {地球|ちきゅう}を{周回|しゅうかい}する (to orbit the Earth)
- {最終|さいしゅう}{周回|しゅうかい} (final lap)

In motorsport and running, {周回|しゅうかい}{遅|おく}れ is also used figuratively to mean being far behind others in terms of knowledge, technology, or trends.
